subject: Mid‑quarter check: OKR scope trim, critical handoffs, and QBR artifacts
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Laura Chen <laura.chen@bridgepoint.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-02 09:12 -0700
Subject: Mid‑quarter check: OKR scope trim, critical handoffs, and QBR artifacts

Team / Laura —

Quick mid‑quarter status and a set of asks ahead of next week's QBR. TL;DR: feature scope needs to be tightened to hit our latency and reliability OKRs; we have three cross‑team handoffs that require firm dates from engineering and procurement. I attached an updated QBR deck and the OKR heatmap for Team B.

Where we are (short):
- Productization: core inference routing (OKR‑R1) is at 65% — integration tests in staging passing but perf tail still +40ms vs target.
- Cost optimization: mem/cache work (OKR‑C2) landed in prototype, but rollout blocked by a config dependency in infra.
- Integrations: Acme Health pilot (OKR‑P1) is on track for an initial sandbox demo but requires a contract addendum and a minor API mapping change.

Asks (concrete):
1) Karthik — need an estimated completion date for the mem/cache rollout gate (infra flag) and whether this can be prioritized into the next sprint. If not, we should explicitly re‑scope the rollout for Q4.
2) Naomi / Tessa — please confirm which metrics we'll surface in the QBR single‑slide heatmap (latency p95, cost per 1k tokens, success rate) and any customer anecdotes we should highlight.
3) Laura / Acme procurement — we need the signed addendum (DocuSign link in the doc) by 8/6 to keep the pilot timeline. If procurement needs a PO or SOW language, flag it now so we don't delay the sandbox demo.

I'll run a dry run of the QBR deck with Markus and Vanessa on 8/05 at 11am; please circulate any edits to the deck by EOD 8/04.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Head of GTM Strategy, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attach: QBR_prep_deck_v2.pdf (presentation), OKR_heatmap_teamB.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@bridgepoint.com>
Date: 2026-08-02 10:36 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid‑quarter check: OKR scope trim, critical handoffs, and QBR artifacts

Marissa —

Quick update on infra flag for mem/cache rollout:\n- Root cause: the feature flag depends on a small config migration in the autoscaler service that has to be rolled out carefully (risk: transient pod restarts can drop long‑polling inference streams).\n- Current plan: I can land the migration in the feature branch by 8/04; staged rollout to Canary nodes 8/06; full rollout 8/11, subject to canary metrics.\n
If the QBR asks for a firm date to show impact on cost, the conservative date is 8/11. If we want to accelerate, we need a dedicated 48‑hour ops window next week (ops on standby) and an SRE owner to run the canary — I can make that happen if leadership signs off.

Impact on OKRs: shipping to canary (8/06) lets us show a preliminary cost delta in the QBR; full rollout (8/11) would be the meaningful reduction.

I recommend we present the conservative path in the deck and note the accelerated option as an "SLA‑backed" tradeoff.

— Karthik

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@bridgepoint.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-03 08:15 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid‑quarter check: OKR scope trim, critical handoffs, and QBR artifacts

Thanks — good notes. For the QBR heatmap slide I propose we surface: latency p95 (pre/post cache where available), cost per 1k tokens, success rate (5xx or retry surface), and pilot readiness (yes/no) per customer.

Customer anecdote: Acme's product ops noted that model fallbacks had surfaced odd truncation on long prompts during the alpha test — we should include a one‑line "what we learned" and next action (fix tokenizer edge case and add fallback instrumentation). Laura, can you confirm that aligns with what you saw?

Also: Tessa and I will update the deck with a "risks & mitigations" half‑slide (calls out the infra flag, procurement timing, and canary risk). We'll attach runbooks for the canary plan as a backup slide.

Action items we own: Naomi/Tessa — deck edits and risk slide by 8/04 EOD. Karthik — canary timeline confirmation (prefer by 8/04). Laura/Acme — procurement signoff by 8/06.

— Naomi

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@bridgepoint.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-04 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid‑quarter check: OKR scope trim, critical handoffs, and QBR artifacts

Hi all —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick answers from Acme: procurement is reviewing the addendum today; I expect signoff by 8/06 (they asked for a minor clarification on data retention language — we've proposed the standard 90/365 wording in the addendum).

About the product ops note: yes — we saw truncation on prompts > 4,000 tokens when fallbacks triggered. Our engineering lead asked for an explicit mapping table for the tokenizer edge cases and a test harness. We'll share that by 8/05.

Sandbox demo: still good for the week of 8/10 assuming procurement signs on 8/06. If the canary rollout slips past 8/11 that only affects cost data we plan to show, not the functional demo.

Laura
Product Lead, Bridgepoint (Acme Health integration)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Laura Chen <laura.chen@bridgepoint.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-05 16:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid‑quarter check: OKR scope trim, critical handoffs, and QBR artifacts — final ask list

Appreciate the rapid turn. Finalizing actions before the dry run: 

1) Karthik — please confirm the canary runbook owner and post the canary success criteria to the shared drive by 8/05 COB. If you want the ops window, I need a one‑line ask (SRE + 48h window) to present at the dry run.
2) Naomi / Tessa — heatmap slide + risk slide live in the deck; please add 2 bullets under "what we learned" referencing the Acme tokenizer note and the fallback instrumentation plan.
3) Laura / Procurement — hold to 8/06 signoff if possible; if procurement needs an SOW/PO, attach it to the DocuSign thread and CC me.

I'll consolidate the deck with those edits and circulate v2 for the 8/05 11:00 dry run. If anything slips, we'll call an 8/05 18:00 catch‑up.

Thanks all — looking forward to a tight QBR flow.

Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Head of GTM Strategy, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachments referenced: QBR_prep_deck_v2.pdf, OKR_heatmap_teamB.xlsx, Acme_integration_MVP_spec.docx
